name: Newry City Core Photogrammetry Point Cloud (3D)
provider: Newry, Mourne and Down District Council
description: RGB-coloured point cloud of the Newry city core, derived by photogrammetry (Agisoft PhotoScan) and streamed in 3D as an OGC 3D-Tiles octree. Rendered with deck.gl interleaved into the map in its true survey colour: tilt and zoom in and the individual scanned points load in place; zoom out and they unload. Level-of-detail streaming keeps performance bounded regardless of dataset size.
